Join us in getting a look at the universe as it has never been seen before.
On Dec. 7, at 3:30pm ET (2030 UTC), @NASARoman’s first images will be unveiled during a livestream from @theAGU Annual Meeting. Learn how to tune in: go.nasa.gov/4ABQ4Bt

node.content-desc: Image: A photo of the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope in the middle of a clean room. Two clean room technicians are looking at the telescope in the foreground.

Who can be a NASA astronaut? The answer may be different than you think.
Applications for astronaut candidates are open until Dec. 3, and we want you to apply! Our current class of astronaut candidates is here to bust some eligibility myths. More info: go.nasa.gov/astro2026
